Both packages now typecheck with no errors. There's no `tsconfig.json` at the repo root, so I ran `npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `packages/api` and `packages/runtime` instead. I didn't run the test suites.

**`packages/runtime`: undid a wrong codemod edit.** In `src/react/registry/ai-chat.tsx` the codemod had renamed `system` to `instructions` in three of the repo's own style tables (`messageRow`, `messageBubble`, `avatarBubble`). These aren't AI SDK messages. They're keyed by the component's own `role` prop, which is still `'user' | 'assistant' | 'system' | 'tool'`, and the code still checks `role === 'system'` further down. I put `system` back in all three, which fixes both errors at lines 252 and 281 and keeps the v6 styling for system messages.

**`packages/api`: `ToolExecutionOptions` now needs a type argument in v7.** The argument is the type of a new `context` field.
- **`src/ai-sdk/index.ts:534`:** changed to `ToolExecutionOptions<unknown>`. The function only reads `options.abortSignal`, so behaviour is unchanged.
- **`test/ai-sdk-tools.test.ts:57` and `:66`:** added the same `<unknown>` to the test helper's types.
- **The test helper also needed a new field.** v7 requires `context` on the options object, so the `callOptions` helper now sets `context: undefined`. That's the value the SDK itself passes when no tool context is given. This is the one place I added a field to test code rather than only fixing a type. Nothing in the tool reads `context`, so no test checks less than before.
